title: The Midnight Login
briefing: A routine morning review at Northbridge Fictional Corp flagged unusual authentication activity around midnight. Investigate the simulated login records, separate key clues from routine activity, and recommend a safe response.
learning_objectives: Analyze timestamps, failed and successful login attempts, usernames, and source IPs in authentication logs
Distinguish suspicious off-hours sign-in activity from normal routine operations
Choose a safe account-protection response and explain the reasoning

evidence.title: Midnight Authentication Log Extract
evidence.content:

evidence.title: Employee Profile & Sign-In Baseline
evidence.content:
Employee: Devon Chen (d.chen@northbridge.example.test)
Department: Accounting
Standard Work Schedule: Mon-Fri 08:30-17:00 local (no overnight shift)
Typical Access Baseline: Internal subnet 10.20.4.0/24 during business hours

decisions.prompt: Given the failed login attempts followed by a successful login from an external IP just after midnight, what should you do first?
options: Ignore the alert because a login eventually succeeded
Reset the account password, revoke active sessions, and escalate to security/IT for investigation
Delete the authentication logs to clear the alert
decisions.feedback_correct: Resetting credentials, revoking sessions, and escalating to security/IT helps contain a potential account compromise while preserving logs.
decisions.feedback_incorrect: Ignoring suspicious off-hours login bursts or deleting logs can leave a compromised account active or remove helpful evidence.

hints.text: Start by checking the timestamps and looking for failed login attempts right before a successful sign-in.
Compare the authentication log extract and employee baseline against routine scheduled service activity.
Inspect the repeated failures followed by a success for d.chen from external IP 198.51.100.42 outside normal hours.
Repeated failed logins followed by a successful sign-in from an unusual IP or off-hours time can indicate credential guessing or account compromise.

conclusion.prompt: Summarize what the login evidence shows, why it is suspicious, and what response action you recommend.
